20217.long_desc:
Our 26 inch 4:3 ratio offer 2880x2160 resolution Arcooda LCD arcade monitor offers the widest range of inputs in the market and supports native 15khz, 24khz and 31khz arcade games, retro 240p, 480p, 640p PC inputs, and ultra high definition up to 2880x2160. It is the perfect replacement for your CRT tube monitor, display walls, advertising or PC gaming needs. ARCADE MACHINE & GAMING INDUSTRY
  • supports multiple variations of 15khz, 25kz, 31khz, arcade gaming resolutions.
  • latest firmware, over 10 years of constant firmware upgrades offering the widest possible support for most arcade game boards on "plug and play basis". From Neo Geo arcade game boards, to Taito X2, Namco System 256, Sega Triforce and your standard JAMMA arcade game boards.
  • auto picture function that works, tuned with real arcade game boards. Just press the auto button for perfect centering of your arcade picture.
  • multiple mounting options including angle brackets (included) rear mounting connection, and VESA mount. This offers the widest mounting options.
  • breakout OSD monitor control board (optional). Mount the monitor adjustment board where it matters, in front of you.
  • RGB adapter PCB (optional) for plug and play with almost any CRT tube monitor wiring. This board also offers fine tuning of color via red,blue,green color potentiometers
  • full angle viewing is perfect for all arcade machines.
  • multiple screen adjustments including picture rotate function.
    • HOME RETRO, PC GAMING & DIGITAL DISPLAY
  • low display lag
  • over 160 pre-programmed PC input modes including 240p, 480p, 720p, up to 2880x2160
  • Freesync, Ultra HDR, DDCCI, UltraVivid, plus other monitor display settings
  • offering full display angle viewing with 1.07B color reproduction, 1000:1 contrast ratio
  • VESA mounting for easy desktop mounting
  • connect Steam or other gaming libraries via Displayport, for HD gaming
  • connect breakout speakers via the 3.5mm audio jack
  • remote control function (optional)
    • NOTES: - this monitor supports audio out via the 3.5mm audio jack. The audio cable provided with the monitor must be used, together with passive (non powered) speakers. - the 4x3 monitor supports all PC resolutions, up to 2880x2160 for Windows and Apple plug and play. This is our recommended 26inch monitor for high resolution PC/visual display and gaming. The Arcooda arcade monitor firmware has been refined over many years.
